fields.Name: New
fields.Description: A first sale to a new customer. (Was seeded as code NEWBIZ / name "New Business" in S1; renamed to match master plan §4.2, which specifies exactly New, Upsell and Renewal. A rename costs nothing precisely because no code was ever aware of either name — that is Rule 2 paying for itself.)

fields.Name: Upsell
fields.Description: More of what the customer already buys, or a step up in tier — seats, volume, edition. A separate deal against the same contract, which is why the relationship is one contract to many deals. (Reuses the row seeded in S1 as EXPANSION: the same concept under the plan's word for it.)

fields.Name: Renewal
fields.Description: Continuation of an existing agreement. RequiresRenewalSource is what makes the chain enforceable: the deal must name the contract it renews (Deal.RenewsContractID), and closing it routes to Contracts.RenewTerm rather than Contracts.CreateFromDeal.
